actionable_steps.citation: Virtues are the Foundation of Peace — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-26
actionable_steps.step: Work at freedom from attachment and hatred — where raga and dwesha rule, peace cannot stay.

actionable_steps.citation: Do Constant Namasmarana for Mental Peace — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37 (2004), 2004-08-23
actionable_steps.step: Chant the Divine Name constantly — contemplation of God alone can bring mental peace; no other means can.

actionable_steps.citation: Virtues are the Foundation of Peace — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-26
actionable_steps.step: Purify your heart — take care not to allow evil qualities to enter it, and develop the power to keep them under check.

actionable_steps.citation: Virtues are the Foundation of Peace — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-26
actionable_steps.step: Stop hunting for peace outside — manifest it from within through practices that purify the mind.
Develop love — it is the only means to get peace; the fuel of love yields the divine flame of peace.

definition.citation: Virtues are the Foundation of Peace — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-26
definition.quote: The state of freedom from attachment (raga) and hatred (dwesha) is real peace. Where there is attachment and hatred, there can be no peace.

discourses.citation: Virtues are the Foundation of Peace — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-26
discourses.quote: Peace is the crown of noble souls. … Peace is the inner wealth of every man. … Your peace is within you; you need not go to anybody else in search of peace.

discourses.citation: Virtues are the Foundation of Peace — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-26
discourses.quote: World peace can be achieved when you develop inner peace. Everything is the reflection of your inner being. You can have peace in your house when you yourself have peace. How can you impart peace to others when you yourself lack it?

discourses.citation: Dedicate all actions to God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 28 (1995), 1995-08-18
discourses.quote: Peace is the highest spiritual discipline. … There is no greater penance than shantham (tranquillity or peace). Peace is the foremost prize for man.

discourses.citation: Do Constant Namasmarana for Mental Peace — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37 (2004), 2004-08-23
discourses.quote: Contemplation of God alone can bring about mental peace and happiness. No other means can achieve this.

make_it_real: Peace isn't found — it's uncovered. Clear one attachment or one hatred today, and feel the peace that was already there.
title: Peace (Shanti)

vahinis.quote: Love is the only means to get peace. The fuel of love yields the divine flame of peace. … Peace is the very nature of the Atma. It coexists only with a pure heart.
